newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NTINI BOWLS BORDER TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NTINI BOWLS BORDER TO VICTORY.

text.p: A devastating spell with the second new ball from Makhaya Ntini bowled Border to victory over Griqualand West in their Supersport Series cricket match in East London on Monday.
Ntini extracted pace and prodigious bounce from the wicket to take four for 32 from an 11-over spell as Griquas brave chase of 340 caved in.
They were bowled out for 299 with just 13 balls remaining to lose by 40 runs.
A gutsy 82 from nightwatchman Wendell Bossenger and 67 from Micky Arthur had put their side in the driving seat at 223 for three at tea.
But Ntini was tossed the new ball after the resumption and quickly removed both Bossenger and Piet Barnard (30) to set the collapse in train.
The last seven wickets fell for just 62 runs with Dion Taljard picking up the final two wickets after the ninth wicket pair threatened to force a draw with a 37 run partnership.
